01 / Your brief

What your vehicles need to say.

A mobile mechanic needs their service and number legible at a kerbside call-out. A detailing van has room for a signature finish, while a courtesy car may only need a discreet logo and a way to book. Decide what each vehicle needs to communicate before choosing the coverage. See our van wraps in Norwich for partial and full coverage options.

05 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Put the service where people see it

Give mobile mechanic, detailing or recovery its own line. Keep the main contact detail readable on the rear.

02

Match coverage to the vehicle’s role

Repeat your colours across the fleet and give a demonstrator more room for imagery.

03

Flag coatings and previous repairs

Tell us about ceramic coatings, existing film and repainting so the surface can be assessed before fitting.

Before you book

Good to know.

Can you wrap a van with a ceramic coating?

Tell us what product was used and when it was applied. We can assess the surface and advise on preparation before agreeing to fit.

Can a courtesy car use the same colours as the workshop van?

Yes. A simplified layout can share the same colours and logo while allowing for the smaller panels and windows.

What details help you quote for a recovery vehicle?

Send body type, dimensions and photos, and mention fixed equipment and any required visibility markings.
